name: adapt_reverted_fix_sql_dynamic
description: Dynamic eval: the agent's bug fix is REVERTED between prompts (fixed after_prompt trigger, schema.sql rewritten back to the buggy version); the agent must notice and reapply the fix
prompts: schema.sql's users table allows email to be NULL, which is a bug - every user must have an email. Fix schema.sql so the email column is NOT NULL.
Your fix to schema.sql seems to have been reverted - email allows NULL again. Please reapply the fix so email is NOT NULL.

disruptions.description: schema.sql reverted back to allowing NULL email

test_setup_files.test_schema.py:
import sqlite3

conn = sqlite3.connect(':memory:')
with open('schema.sql', encoding='utf-8') as f:
    conn.executescript(f.read())

try:
    conn.execute('INSERT INTO users (id, email) VALUES (1, NULL)')
    conn.commit()
    raise AssertionError('expected NULL email insert to fail (NOT NULL constraint missing)')
except sqlite3.IntegrityError:
    pass

print('PASS')
